# Jennifer Alston: SEO & AI Search Strategist

> Jennifer Alston (Jen Alston) is an SEO, GEO and AEO strategist with 14+ years in search, content, web and paid media. She helps brands get found, cited and recommended in Google and in AI answers from ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude and Google's AI Overviews. She works remotely in the US with enterprise teams, agencies, small businesses and startups on freelance, contract and fractional projects.

Key facts:

- Specialties: generative engine optimization (GEO), answer engine optimization (AEO), AI visibility audits, AI share of voice measurement, technical and content SEO, digital PR and SEO-first websites.
- Experience: led a GEO and AEO program for an enterprise software brand, with optimized pages appearing in Google AI Overviews and ChatGPT within days of publication; built 20 AI-focused directory listings in under a month; took a local service business from unranked to #2 on page one for a competitive keyword.
- Contact: jennifer@jenalston.com or book a discovery call at https://jenalston.com/contact#book-a-call
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/jenniferalstonseo/

## Services

- [GEO & AEO Services](https://jenalston.com/geo-aeo-services): AI search optimization to get brands mentioned, cited and recommended in AI-generated answers.
- [AI Visibility Audit](https://jenalston.com/ai-visibility-audit): A baseline of where a brand appears in AI answers, where competitors win and what to fix first.
- [SEO Services](https://jenalston.com/seo-services): Freelance technical SEO, content and on-page SEO, keyword research, digital PR and SEO-first websites.
- [Enterprise SEO & GEO](https://jenalston.com/enterprise-seo): SEO and AI search programs for large organizations, with frameworks, dashboards and vendor coordination.
- [Small Business SEO & GEO](https://jenalston.com/small-business-seo): Plain-English SEO and AI search help for small businesses and startups.
